select dsi.id, dsi.name, dsi.platform_name, dsi.site, dsi.charge_name, dsi.status, dsi.store_sign, dsi.create_user_name, dsi.create_time, dsi.update_user_name, dsi.update_time from dmp_shop_info dsi
and dsi.name like concat('%',#{params.shopName},'%')
and dsi.platform_name like concat('%',#{params.platformName},'%')
and dsi.site like concat('%',#{params.site},'%')
and dsi.create_time >= #{params.createTime_begin}::timestamp
and dsi.create_time <= #{params.createTime_end}::timestamp
${params.param}
